paite: Hichi ahong hi a, kulhbaang lam khit ahih a, kongkhakte ka tun khit a, kongkhak ngak mite leh lasa mite leh Levi mite seh ahih khit nung un,
heading: Jerusalem Kongpi A Vengmi Sehna
english: Now when the wall was built and I had set up the doors, and the gatekeepers and the singers and the Levites were appointed,

paite: ka unau Hanani leh Hananiah kulh ukpa kiang ah Jerusalem kepna ka pia a: amah miginom ahi a, tampi sang a Pathian laudan siam ahih ziak in.
english: I put my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the governor of the fortress, in charge of Jerusalem; for he was a faithful man and feared God above many.

paite: Akiang ah, "Ni asat mateng Jerusalem kongpite hon hi kei hen; galvilmi adin lai un, kongkhakte khak uhenla, amaute kalhkhum un; Jerusalem a tengte vengmi sep inla, michih ama dinmun ah, michih ama inn zawn chiat ah," chi in.
english: I said to them, “Don’t let the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot; and while they stand guard, let them shut the doors, and you bar them; and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, everyone in his watch, with everyone near his house.”

paite: Khopi aza in alian a: himahleh huai ah mite atawm ua, innte lah lam ahi kei uhi.
heading: Saltanna A Kipan Hong Kik Nawnte / (Ezr 2.1-70)
english: Now the city was wide and large; but the people were few therein, and the houses were not built.

paite: Huchi in ka Pathian in ka lungtang miliante, vaihawm mite, mipite, khangsutna a sim ahihtheihna ding ua kaikhawm ding in akoih hi. Huan amasapen a hong lang amaute khangsutna laibu ka muta a, huai ah gelh a om ka mu hi.
english: My God put into my heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be listed by genealogy. I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up at the first, and I found this written in it:

paite: Hiaite bial naupangte ahi ua, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in apimangte, huai pimang a omte lak a saltanna kipan a paitoute, Jerusalem leh Judah akik nawn, michih amah khopi a kik;
english: These are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and who returned to Jerusalem and to Judah, everyone to his city,

paite: Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordekai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah toh hong paite.
english: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, and Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

paite: Israel mite lak a pasal zah: Parosh suante, sangnih zakhat sawmsagih-le-nih.
english: The children of Parosh: two thousand one hundred seventy-two.
The children of Shephatiah: three hundred seventy-two.
The children of Arah: six hundred fifty-two.

paite: Pahath-moab suante, Jeshua leh Joab tate, sangnih zagiat sawmkhat-le-giat.
english: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab: two thousand eight hundred eighteen.
The children of Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.
The children of Zattu: eight hundred forty-five.
The children of Zaccai: seven hundred sixty.
The children of Binnui: six hundred forty-eight.
The children of Bebai: six hundred twenty-eight.
The children of Azgad: two thousand three hundred twenty-two.
The children of Adonikam: six hundred sixty-seven.
The children of Bigvai: two thousand sixty-seven.
The children of Adin: six hundred fifty-five.
The children of Ater: of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.
The children of Hashum: three hundred twenty-eight.
The children of Bezai: three hundred twenty-four.
The children of Hariph: one hundred twelve.
The children of Gibeon: ninety-five.

paite: Bethlehem leh Netophah suan zakhat sawmgiat-le-giat.
english: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah: one hundred eighty-eight.
The men of Anathoth: one hundred twenty-eight.
The men of Beth Azmaveth: forty-two.

paite: Kiriath-jearim, Kephirah, Beeroth suante, zasagih sawmli-le-thum.
english: The men of Kiriath Jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth: seven hundred forty-three.

paite: Ramah leh Geba mite, zaguk sawmnih-le-khat.
english: The men of Ramah and Geba: six hundred twenty-one.
The men of Michmas: one hundred twenty-two.

paite: Bethel leh Ai mite, zakhat sawmnih-le-thum.
english: The men of Bethel and Ai: one hundred twenty-three.
The men of the other Nebo: fifty-two.

paite: Elam dang suan sangkhat zanih sawmnga-le-li.
english: The children of the other Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.
The children of Harim: three hundred twenty.
The children of Jericho: three hundred forty-five.

paite: Lod, Hadid leh Ono suante, zasagih sawmnih-le-khat.
english: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono: seven hundred twenty-one.
The children of Senaah: three thousand nine hundred thirty.

paite: Siampute: Jedaiah suante, Jeshua inkuan a kipan, zakua sawmsagih-le-thum.
english: The priests: The children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua: nine hundred seventy-three.
The children of Immer: one thousand fifty-two.
The children of Pashhur: one thousand two hundred forty-seven.
The children of Harim: one thousand seventeen.

paite: Levi mite: Jeshua, Kadmiel suante, Hodevah suante, sawmsagih-le-li.
english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, of the children of Hodevah: seventy-four.

paite: Lasa mite: Asaph suante, zakhat sawmli-le-giat.
english: The singers: the children of Asaph: one hundred forty-eight.

paite: Kongkhak ngakte: Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita leh Shobai suante, zakhat sawmthum-le-giat.
english: The gatekeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai: one hundred thirty-eight.

paite: Tempul nasem, Nethinim mite: Ziha, Hasupha, Tabbaoth;
english: The temple servants: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,
the children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,
the children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Salmai,
the children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,
the children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,
the children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah,
the children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephushesim,
the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
the children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,
the children of Neziah, and the children of Hatipha.

paite: Solomon sikhate tate: Sotai, Sophereth, Perida;
english: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,
the children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

paite: Shephatiah, Hattil, Zebaim mi Pokereth leh Ammon suante.
english: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, and the children of Amon.

paite: Nethinim mite tengteng leh Solomon sikhate' suante, zathum sawmkua-le-nih.
english: All the temple servants and the children of Solomon’s servants were three hundred ninety-two.

paite: uan hiaite Telmelah, Tel-harsha, Kerub, Addon leh Immer a kipan paitoute ahi uh, himahleh apipute uh inkote, Israel a kipan ahi hiam chih bel a-ensak thei kei uhi:
english: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses, nor their offspring, whether they were of Israel:

paite: Delaiah, Tobiah leh Nekoda suante, zaguk sawmli-le-nih.
english: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda: six hundred forty-two.

paite: Siampute a kipan: Habaiah, Koz leh Barzillai suan Gilead mi Barzillai tanute lak a zi neipa min atamsak uhi.
english: Of the priests: the children of Hobaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.

paite: Hiaite'n khangthu suina a sim a omte lak ah amin gelhna uh azong ua, himahleh muh in a-om kei; huaiziak in nin a sim ahi ua siamputna a kipan koihkhiak ahi uhi.
english: These searched for their genealogical records, but couldn’t find them. Therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.

paite: Ukpipa in akiang uah, siampu khat Urim leh Thummim toh ahong suah mateng thil siangthoupente lak a nek louh ding chih agen hi.
english: The governor told them not to eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to minister with Urim and Thummim.

paite: Omkhawm tengteng avek un singli sangnih zathum-le-sawmguk,
english: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,

paite: Apasal sikhate uh leh anungak sikhate uh, sangsagih zathum sawmthum-le-sagihte sim louh in: pasal lasa leh numei lasa zanih sawmli-le-nga anei uhi.
english: in addition to their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven. They had two hundred forty-five singing men and singing women.

paite: Asakolte uh zasagih sawmthum-le-guk; asakolneute uh, zanih sawmli-le-nga;
english: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five;

paite: Asangawngsaute, zali sawmthum-le-nga; asabiltungte uh sangguk zasagih-le-sawmnih.
english: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty.

paite: Pipute inkote lak a lupente lak a kipan khenkhatte nasem ding in akipia uhi. Ukpipa'n sumbawm ah dangka- eng darik sangkhat, maiphiat kuang sawmnga, siampute puan zanga-le- sawmthum apia hi.
english: Some from among the heads of fathers’ households gave to the work. The governor gave to the treasury one thousand darics of gold, fifty basins, and five hundred thirty priests’ garments.

paite: Huan pipute inkote lak a lupente lak a khenkhatte'n dangka-eng darik singnih leh, dangka paun sangnih-le-zanih apia uhi.
english: Some of the heads of fathers’ households gave into the treasury of the work twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand two hundred minas of silver.

paite: Mipite lak a adangdangte piak dangka-eng darik singnih leh dangka paun sangnih leh, siampute puan sawmguk-le- sagih ahi.
english: That which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand darics of gold, plus two thousand minas of silver, and sixty-seven priests’ garments.

paite: Huchi in siampute, Levi mite, kongkhak ngakte leh lasa mite, mite lak a akhente leh Nethinim mite leh Israel tengteng a khopite uah atengta uhi. Akha sagihna ahong tun in, Israel suante akhopite uah a-om uhi.
english: So the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, some of the people, the temple servants, and all Israel lived in their cities. When the seventh month had come, the children of Israel were in their cities.
